## What's being proposed

A clear description of the new stack / agent / skill / prompt category (or category of prompts) you're proposing.

## Why

What gap does this close? What's the concrete problem today — a stack Dotsquares delivery teams actually use that has no agent/skill coverage yet, a recurring task with no reusable prompt, etc. — not just "would be nice to have."

## Modeled on

This platform's own convention (see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)) is not to invent structure from scratch. Which existing agent, skill, or wiki page is the closest structural match for what you're proposing?

- Closest existing agent (`.claude/agents/...`):
- Closest existing skill (`.claude/skills/...`):
- Closest existing wiki page (`wiki/...`):

- New files expected (agent, skill, wiki page, prompts, starter project under `templates/starter-projects/`, etc.):
- Existing files that would need cross-reference updates (e.g. `wiki/Home.md`, `prompts/README.md`):

Anything else relevant — a client engagement that surfaced the gap, related discussion, prior art elsewhere in the repo.
